title: RTI Researcher
description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking researchers for our real-time information team. You see the opportunity in generating alpha from real-time events. You possess a rational aptitude for interpreting how news originates, disseminates, and affects prices. You are a strategic thinker who can distinguish signal from noise. You have a growth mindset and consistently become faster and smarter. You have potential or credentials at software development or math.

Responsibilities

  • Basic science - Identify market-moving news signals by observation and querying of news and market data.
  • Historical analysis - Catalog, study, and model the market impact of news signals.
  • Scheduled event focus - Create calendar of important events, watch them live.
  • Real-Time monitoring - Watch newsfeeds and alert traders/researchers to time-sensitive updates.
  • Manage automated news alerts - Backtest, stress-test, and deploy high precision/recall automated alerts for themes of interest. Then, pay attention to changing market conditions and update as necessary.
  • Develop market competence - Internalize context and pricing for liquid crypto assets

Requirements

  • Degree in a related field (finance, engineering, math, social science with a concentration on economics/finance), or demonstrable fluency in same
  • Experience using news platforms such as X Pro, Bloomberg Terminal, discord/telegram chats, etc
  • Serious ambition to play a high-stakes, ultra-competitive game

Operational & Communication Skills:

  • Attention to detail
  • Reliability
  • Ability to articulate key insights quickly

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Interview – A discussion with the Head of HR to better understand your background, career motivations, and overall alignment.
  3. First Interview – Interview with our Senior RTI Researcher on your experience, motivation, and general technical knowledge.
  4. Second Interview – Interview with the broader RTI Research & Engineering team, with a deeper focus on technical skills and role fit.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

title: Lead Engineer - ME Integration
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

At Scout Motors, you don't just design vehicles- you shape the future of the road. Our Engineering team is where bold ideas meet rigorous execution, building machines that are as durable and capable as the people who drive them. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant minds across disciplines, turning complex challenges into elegant, scalable solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, performance, and user experience. This is a place where your fingerprints are found on metal – where what you design gets built, driven, and remembered. If you're hungry to engineer something that matters, Scout Motors is where that ambition finds its highest gear.

We are seeking a Lead Engineer – Manufacturing Integration & Release Testing to drive vehicle-side integration, manufacturing software deployment, and production validation activities for next-generation Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) platforms. This role combines manufacturing integration, release engineering, automated testing, and vehicle validation to ensure production-ready software and hardware releases across factory environments. The engineer will lead end-to-end workflows spanning ECU flashing, factory software provisioning, manufacturing release qualification, EOL testing, and vehicle-level validation. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in automotive integration, manufacturing systems, embedded software validation, and automation within fast-paced engineering environments.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Lead integration of vehicle software and ECU systems into manufacturing and production environments.
  • Develop scalable workflows for ECU flashing, calibration deployment, secure software installation, VIN-based configuration, factory diagnostics
  • Support integration across body ECUs, gateway systems, infotainment, ADAS/Autonomy modules, connectivity systems
  • Develop and execute automated test strategies for manufacturing software releases, ECU firmware validation, factory release readiness, vehicle configuration verification, production regression testing, flash and rollback testing
  • Build automated release gates ensuring software quality before deployment into production lines.
  • Validate compatibility between vehicle software versions, manufacturing tooling, diagnostics, and plant infrastructure.
  • Develop automation for ECU communication validation, network integrity checks, vehicle health diagnostics, firmware integrity validation
  • Validation responsible for network topology, gateway routing strategies, signal database integrity (DBC, ARXML), bandwidth utilization and bus loading
  • Validate and manage vehicle communication across CAN / CAN-FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet (100/1000BASE-T1), FlexRay network framework
  • Validate and release bootloader compatibility, flashing strategy, partitioning strategy (AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive), Memory and CPU utilization budgets
  • Coordinate integration across Powertrain / Electrification (BMS, inverter, charging), Body & Comfort, ADAS / AD compute platforms, Infotainment & Connectivity, Central Compute / Zonal Controllers
  • Ensure feature-level integration synchronization, power mode management, Wake-up/sleep strategy robustness.
  • Own system-level regression test planning, drive root cause analysis of cross-domain issues and help support integration war-room activities during DV/PV builds.
  • Leadership Competencies
    • Strong system-level thinking, technical arbitration capability
    • Structured problem solving
    • Program milestone ownership, ability to operate in high-pressure launch environments

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.
  • This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 12+ yrs. Of experience
  • Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architecture and ECU-level software stacks, automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) and diagnostic communication tools
  • Expert knowledge of Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, and Artifactory. ALM/PLM Proficiency in Siemens Polarion, IBM DOORS Next Gen, or PTC Windchill.
  • Strong understanding, development and verification of plant and control models in MATLAB/Simulink for execution in hardware in the loop test environment, dSpace control desk and automation desk
  • Strong understanding of 1st principles in Engineering, result/solution oriented.
  • Familiarity with SW for embedded systems, EE systems and architecture
  • Familiarity with A2B, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, LVDS communication protocols and Vehicle Network tools, such as CANalyzer, CANoe, etc.‚
  • Expertise with complex problem solving, data analysis, access/interpret/drive results with extended teams.
  • Knowledge of Automotive design and development process, system requirements, and general engineering best practices

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $160,000.00 - $192,500.00

Internal leveling code: IC7

Notice to applicants:

  • To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.
  • Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

title: Software-Based Load Balancing Expert - remote - consultancy
description:
This is a remote position.

The objective is to learn from practical experience how software-based load balancing can provide the required capabilities without relying on hardware load balancer appliances.

  • Strong knowledge of HTTP, HTTPS, TCP and SSL termination

  • Experience with header/content rewriting is beneficial

title: Pædagogisk håndværker/Handyman søges til Jobberiet
description:
Allerød Kommune søger en medarbejder med håndværksmæssig baggrund og erfaring inden for det pædagogiske felt. Stillingen er på 30-37 timer ugentligt, og ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Allerød Kommune har samlet aktiveringsindsatsen for ledige i Jobberiet, hvor omdrejningspunktet er praksisnær oplæring i forskellige konkrete arbejdsopgaver med fokus på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse, udførsel og kvalitetskontrol samt det at indgå i det kollegiale samarbejde. Jobberiet består af forskellige ”værksteder”, hvor den enkelte borger alt efter interesse og kompetencer vil blive tilknyttet.

Der er behov for en målrettet indsats med fokus på såvel træning af mødestabilitet, faglige, sociale og sproglige kompetencer i rammer, hvor det kan tages hensyn til den enkeltes udfordringer og potentialer.

I alle funktioner, undervisning og arbejdsopgaver indgår motivation, træning og tilskyndelse til jobsøgning som primær værdi, for at understøtte at den enkelte opnår de nødvendige kompetencer for at kunne indgå
på arbejdsmarkedet eller i virksomhedsrettet aktivering.

Målet er, at borgeren skal være aktivt jobsøgende samtidig med, at faglige såvel som personlige kompetencer opbygges.

Målgruppen er ledige der modtager offentlig forsørgelse, herunder integrationsborgere.

Om stillingen
Kan du byde ind med faglige kompetencer i forhold til at drive et værksted, der foretager småreparationer
og istandsættelse af Mooncars samt udfør kreativt træarbejde og ad hoc - opgaver, samtidig med at du i samarbejde med dine kollegaer kan motivere og understøtte borgerens vej til arbejdsmarkedet - så er du lige den vi søger.

En væsentlig del af stillingen vil være knyttet til Allerød Kommunes midlertidige boliger, hvor du sammen med borgere fra Jobberiet skal varetage forskellige praktiske opgaver.

Det kan blandt andet være mindre reparationer, lettere vedligeholdelse og mindre klargøringsopgaver i forbindelse med ind- og udflytning samt andre forefaldende praktiske og håndværksmæssige opgaver.

Opgaverne skal samtidig bruges aktivt som en del af borgernes beskæftigelsesrettede forløb. Du skal derfor kunne inddrage borgerne i arbejdet, lære fra dig og tilrettelægge opgaverne, så den enkelte borger får mulighed for at udvikle sine kompetencer og opleve ansvar, progression og succes i konkrete arbejdsopgaver.

Du får dermed en vigtig rolle i både at sikre, at de praktiske opgaver bliver løst, og i at skabe et godt lærings- og arbejdsfællesskab omkring opgaverne.

Du bliver en del af et engageret og fagligt dygtige team bestående af 7 medarbejder, som har fast base i Vassingerød. Herudover er en række øvrige kollegaer tilknyttet huset for at bidrage med deres faglighed – eksempelvis i forhold til jobsøgningsaktiviteter. Der vil være opgaver, som løses på tværs, og vi forventer derfor, at du ser dig selv som en del af det samlede Jobberi og bidrager fleksibelt, hvor der er behov.

Om dig
Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet håndværker eller har særlig håndværksmæssig snilde, som du har brugt i en tidligere ansættelse
  • Har erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde i forhold til voksne
  • Har gode kompetencer ift. at indgå i et dynamisk teamarbejde omkring den enkelte borger
  • Har lyst og evne til at lære fra dig og inddrage borgere aktivt i de praktiske opgaver.
  • Har en naturlig evne til at omgås mennesker og gerne erfaring med at støtte voksne i deres udvikling.
  • Kan møde borgerne anerkendende og samtidig stille tydelige krav til deltagelse, ansvar og kvalitet.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og planlægge dagens opgaver, men samtidig trives i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Kan håndtere pressede borgere
  • Kan bevare overblikket, og agere i en travl hverdag
  • Er engageret, struktureret og har evner og lyst til at arbejde helhedsorienteret
  • Har styr på skriftlig kommunikation og kan dokumentere relevante observationer og udvikling.
  • Har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau (vi arbejder bl.a. i Fasit og Acadre)

Derfor skal du vælge os
Allerød Kommune er en arbejdsplads med en høj social kapital. Vi vægter tværfagligt samarbejde, kompetence- og jobudvikling og ikke mindst medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Det vigtigste for os er vores kerneopgave - at skabe værdi for borgeren.

Vi tilbyder

  • Stilling på 30-37 timer ugentligt efter aftale
  • Flekstidsordning
  • Afvekslende og udfordrende arbejde, hvor ikke 2 dage er ens
  • En stilling med høj grad af selvstændighed og indflydelse samt gode samarbejdsrelationer
  • Engagerede og kompetente kollegaer
  • Fast supervision

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive fastsat efter gældende overenskomst for relevant faglig organisation.

Er du interesseret?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder Hassan Chassebi på tlf. 48 12 65 06 eller på mobil 24 98 90 88
for at høre nærmere om stillingen.

Vi indhenter referencer og straffeoplysninger på alle kommende medarbejdere.

title: Senior Technologist Data Center Fluids
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.

Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.

Job description

About the team

You will join Castrol's global Data Center technology team in Wayne, New Jersey, supporting a strategic growth market driven by AI, digitalization and sustainability. The team works across regions and functions to develop and deploy advanced cooling-fluid solutions for data center applications, partnering closely with Technology, Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, customers and industry stakeholders. As a Senior Technologist Data Center Fluids, you will act as the regional technical contact for Castrol’s Data Center cooling fluids portfolio in the United States. You will bring deep technical expertise in fluids, product development and technology deployment to help translate customer and market needs into practical, safe and reliable solutions. Working as part of a global team, you will support product performance, technical troubleshooting, new product introduction, customer adoption and innovation in emerging data center cooling technologies.

Key tasks

  • Build and maintain deep knowledge of Castrol’s existing and evolving cooling-fluid portfolio, product characteristics, application scenarios, industry standards and specifications.
  • Advise on new technologies, materials, processes and standards, applying strong formulation and performance knowledge to deliver practical solutions for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Benchmark competitor products and support robust performance evaluations that help define Castrol’s value proposition.
  • Support new product launches and technology deployment, ensuring alignment with global standards, substantiated claims and relevant market or regulatory requirements.
  • Lead complex technical troubleshooting using systematic problem-solving methods, including support for root-cause analysis, quality issues, customer complaints and product documentation.
  • Deliver technical presentations and training to internal teams and customers, and help establish operational, service and maintenance guidelines with technical support teams.
  • Lead or support technical projects and collaborate with Marketing, Sales and Supply Chain to enable successful product implementation and customer adoption.
  • Research emerging trends in data center cooling, direct liquid and immersion technologies, and thermal management; support new test methods and equipment and represent Castrol in relevant industry forums.

Experience required

  • Degree in Chemistry, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant experience in technical product development and/or technology deployment, ideally involving water-based fluids.
  • Strong capability in problem analysis, experimental design, data processing and technical reporting.
  • Ability to develop technical ideas into practical solutions and support their deployment in real-world applications.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in an international and intercultural environment.

Preferred experience

  • Hands-on experience with data centers, IT hardware, direct liquid cooling, immersion cooling, thermal management or similar applications.
  • Experience with water-based cooling fluids, industrial lubricants, thermal management fluids or metalworking fluids.
  • Established connections with relevant industry partners, companies, institutes or researchers.

The anticipated salary range for this position is shown below with additional market competitive benefits. Actual placement within this range will be determined by a candidate's relevant experience, skills, and internal equity.

Salary range
$106,000—$151,000 USD

title: Principal Product Manager, Seller Acquisition
description:
About Big Cartel…

Big Cartel is an e-commerce platform that gives creators, artists, makers, and small brands from all over the world the power to open their own online stores and make a living doing what they love. Since 2005, we’ve helped people sell over $4 billion of their work while remaining a 100% independent company. With a passionate team of approximately 40 people, we stand as a haven for small brands connecting their passion with opportunity. As we love to say, “you don’t have to sell out to sell online.”

About the Role…

Big Cartel is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead our Seller Acquisition Product Team. You’ll own the in-product new seller journey across trials, onboarding, shop discovery, and first orders. Your success will be measured on new seller growth and retention through the first 90 days of the seller lifecycle.

You’ll report directly to the Co-CEO and work across engineering, design, growth and product marketing, data, and customer success.

This role is US-based only, is fully remote, and requires closely aligning work schedules to ensure effective collaboration, communication and foster a great team culture.


In this role you will…

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for the first 90 days of the in-product seller journey from trial through first sales

  • Work cross-functionally with designers, engineers, marketing, and customer success to ship, measure, and iterate quickly

  • Design, run, and interpret experiments and A/B tests to continuously improve conversion and activation across the first 90 days of the customer journey

  • Collaborate with Growth Marketing to build the product levers that make acquisition scale and compound economically including SEO +GEO, paid acquisition, social marketing, engagement triggers, and product-led growth loops.

  • Leverage data and direct customer insights to inform product and cross-functional growth recommendations to accelerate key customers objectives directly tied to the team’s charter

  • Measuring and communicating impact clearly, ensuring everything you do is aligned with the company strategy and priorities and drives measurable seller and business growth.

You’ll be a great fit for this role if…

  • You have owned growth, activation, onboarding, and monetization/conversion for a consumer or self-serve subscription product

  • You have strategic and economic fluency across consumer channel acquisition, unit economics, conversion, activation, retention, CAC, LTV, and cohort analyses.

  • You understand the tensions that exist inside, and between, B2B and B2C products. Our sellers are both: a business, and a person deciding whether to bet on themselves this month.

  • You are an AI-native operator driving research synthesis, competitive teardowns, modeling, reporting, and prototyping with AI to validate an idea before spending engineering time on it.

  • You have strong commercial instincts, always directly connecting product decisions to measurable business outcomes

  • You have passion for e-commerce and making complex yet delightfully simple products

  • You prioritize and personally set and model a rapid pace of execution while making thoughtful tradeoffs that balance creating delightful experiences with the realities of business goals and timelines

  • You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable using data to drive decisions, but are also not paralyzed if it doesn’t exist

  • You move between strategic vision and hands-on detail without friction, and you can seamlessly pivot between a scoping conversation with engineering and a channel strategy and data conversation with growth marketing

  • You spend your own time on the few highest-leverage points in a seller's first 90 days and empower a broad, cross-functional team to run the rest of the roadmap autonomously. With AI accelerating engineering, more ships than any one PM can fully shepherd thus you set the priorities and you don't manage every feature and project to the last detail; however, you are accountable for all outcomes

  • You are willing to adopt and live Big Cartel’s values and embrace our high-performance culture leading through modeling behaviors, influence, and high personal accountability to results and behaviors

  • You have 10+ years of product management experience, ideally with meaningful time spent on growth, activation, or subscription conversion

Benefits & perks

Compensation for the role is $190,000 - $210,000. We also offer our employees a full slate of market-competitive benefits, medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k with employer match, flexible time off and mental health resources.

Note: This role is only open to candidates in the United States.

title: Product Designer
description:

We wholeheartedly believe a daily rhythm of seeking intimacy with God has the power to transform lives. That’s why YouVersion creates biblically-based experiences that encourage and challenge people to seek God. We hope everyone in our community is on an active journey to become who God made them to be, abiding in Him, and drawing closer every day.

What You’ll Do

  • Work closely with product management, localization, and engineering teams to facilitate brainstorming and prototyping sessions.
  • Deliver polished comps, flows, and assets across all platforms.
  • Present new design concepts and solutions to Product Management teams and stakeholders.
  • Gather and test user feedback on new concepts.
  • Ensure feedback has been validated and then implemented with proper design consideration.

Skills Needed to Succeed

  • Ability to self-motivate, make independent decisions and find innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding listening skills and the ability to take learning and create a vision and effectively execute.
  • Must exemplify a high level of customer focus.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to initiate the creative and critical thinking processes for oneself and the team.
  • Bachelor's degree in related field
  • 3+ years in human interaction sociology, psychology, interaction/visual design or equivalent.
  • Portfolio of outstanding work.

Benefits We Offer

  • Paid parental leave, including maternity, paternity, and adoption leave.
  • Generous employer-paid leave for the use of vacation, sick time, and other qualifying reasons.
  • Innovative and comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance that provides team members with useful resources and savings to navigate their holistic health.
  • Life insurance policy provided for all staff members at 2x annual salary at no cost. Additional life insurance coverage is available to purchase.

  • Generous 401(k) retirement plan allowing a team member to have up to 12.5% (including employee contribution, employer match, and employer discretionary contribution) contributed into their account in their first year. It doesn’t stop there—the more years on staff, the greater the investment!
  • $160 annually in development dollars for team members to invest in their professional growth.
  • Casual dress and work environment.
  • And much more!

Our Beliefs, Culture, and Commitment to Diversity

At Life.Church, every staff member, and intern is a minister and is expected to engage in the church's ministry fully. We consider ministry readiness and an individual’s capacity to represent Life.Church’s beliefs as a minister during the selection process for all staff and intern positions. An essential function within every position held by a staff member or intern at Life.Church is to uphold and represent the beliefs of Life.Church. Learn more about what we believe at Life.Church.
While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn’t mean uniformity. Our calling is too great, and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team through diversity. We know that diverse perspectives in race, ethnicity, background, age, and gender are essential to reaching the world for Christ. To learn more about how we strengthen our team through diversity, visit our careers page.

title: Middle Backend Developer (PHP · AWS Lambda · AI)
description:
Bear Claw is an AI-powered recruiting and applicant tracking platform built to help recruiters work smarter and place top talent faster. Our platform brings the entire recruiting workflow into one system — from candidate and job management to team collaboration, sourcing, and outreach. At the center is Cora, our conversational AI assistant, which uses vector search and LLM-powered technology to identify candidate-job matches, surface opportunities, and help recruiters take action faster. Bear Claw combines powerful recruiting technology with practical AI to make the hiring process more efficient, intelligent, and scalable.



The experience expected from applicants, as well as additional skills and qualifications needed for this job are listed below.

About the Role


We're looking for a Middle Backend Developer to join our engineering team and help build and scale the services that power our product. You'll spend most of your time working in PHP on a serverless architecture built with AWS Lambda, backed by MySQL. Alongside our core backend, we're investing heavily in AI-driven features — so you'll also support and extend our AI Agent functionality, which is written in Python and backed by PostgreSQL.

This is a hands-on role for someone who writes clean, reliable, well-tested code, cares about doing things the right way, and is excited to build scalable solutions that make use of AI. You'll have real ownership over the features you ship and room to grow toward more senior technical work.


What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services in PHP running on AWS Lambda (serverless).
  • Model, query, and optimize data in MySQL — including schema design, indexing, and query performance.
  • Support, maintain, and extend our AI Agent functionality written in Python and backed by PostgreSQL.
  • Build scalable solutions that leverage AI/LLM capabilities, turning new AI features from prototype into production-grade services.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable code that follows engineering best practices — clear structure, tests, and sensible patterns.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, both giving and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and internal services reliably and securely.
  • Monitor, debug, and optimize the performance, reliability, and cost of serverless functions.
  • Contribute to technical discussions, documentation, and continuous improvement of our codebase and processes.
  • Collaborate closely with product, frontend, and other engineers to deliver features end to end.


What We're Looking For

  • Roughly 2–4 years of professional backend development experience.
  • Strong, practical experience with PHP in a production environment.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda or serverless architecture (and comfort with the AWS ecosystem generally).
  • Solid MySQL skills: relational data modeling, writing efficient queries, and troubleshooting performance.
  • Working knowledge of Python — enough to confidently read, support, and extend the AI agent codebase.
  • Familiarity with PostgreSQL.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs, version control (Git), automated testing, and general software best practices.
  • Genuine interest in AI/LLM-based features and a willingness to grow your skills in that area.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently on well-scoped tasks.


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience building or integrating AI agents / LLM-powered features (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks, and prompt/tooling design).
  • Experience with additional AWS services: API Gateway, SQS, S3, AuroraDB, CloudWatch, Lambda, SNS.
  • Familiarity with event-driven / message-queue architectures.
  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation).
  • Exposure to vector databases or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfort working across two language stacks (PHP + Python) without friction.


What You'll Bring as a Teammate

  • Ownership — you take responsibility for what you ship, from first commit to production.
  • Clear communication — you explain your thinking and collaborate well with others.
  • A quality mindset — you care about clean, tested, maintainable code, not just "make it work."
  • Curiosity — especially about AI and how to apply it in scalable, practical ways.


Perks:

  • Competitive base salary and comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare, vision, dental, and a 401(k).
  • Work closely with like-minded industry professionals dedicated to innovation and success. xhmxlyz
  • Strong company culture of high performance and quality customer care.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

This role is based in San Francisco with four days in-office and one day remote.

What You’ll Do

UnitedMasters is looking for a Staff Product Manager to operate as a force multiplier across the organization: setting product strategy for entire problem spaces, driving outsized business results, and raising the bar for how the entire product team builds. You will obsess over the functional and emotional needs of music creators and independent music labels at every stage of their growth, while pioneering how AI reshapes both what we build for artists and how we build it.

As a Staff PM, you are expected to lead through influence rather than authority, tackle our most ambiguous and highest-leverage problems, and mentor other PMs in the craft. You will partner closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and operations teams to improve and expand the full UnitedMasters product suite including tools for early-stage artists, high-traction artists, and independent record labels:

  • Own product strategy for a major area of the business. Define and champion a multi-quarter, unified product vision and roadmap that supports all of our artists: early-stage artists, artists gaining traction, and independent labels and ensure they have the tools they need to release music, grow an audience, and earn money. Connect that strategy directly to company-level objectives.
  • Pioneer AI-powered artist experiences. Identify, prototype, and ship AI-driven features that create step-change value for creators and labels from intelligent release and audience-growth tooling to earnings insights and creative assistance. Develop a strong point of view on where AI meaningfully improves the artist experience versus where it adds noise, and set the standard for responsible, high-quality AI product development across the company.
  • Raise the bar on team velocity with AI. Champion the adoption of AI tools to accelerate how the product org works using rapid prototyping, AI-assisted research synthesis, reusable AI skills and workflows, and internal agents to compress the path from idea to validated concept to shipped feature. Model these practices for other PMs and help operationalize them across teams.
  • Synthesize signal across all segments. Continuously collect and synthesize artist feedback through research, interviews, product analytics, and our artist-facing teams leveraging AI to accelerate and deepen that synthesis. Translate these insights into clear product requirements and roadmap priorities that increase adoption, satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Own the competitive and technology landscape. Stay deeply informed about the competitive landscape and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem, understanding how other platforms work and identifying opportunities for UnitedMasters to stand out and deliver more value to creators and labels.
  • Master the end-to-end artist experience. Develop a deep understanding of the full artist journey, from onboarding and releasing new music to reviewing performance and earnings ensuring every step is intuitive, reliable, and delightful.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. Collaborate with teams who work directly with artists and labels every day to ensure our tools, features, and support deliver maximum value and help artists succeed.
  • Set the quality bar. Uphold and elevate a high bar of quality across the team, ensuring that everything we launch will delight artists, be easy to use, and attract and retain independent artists and labels.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Proven ability to translate big, ambiguous, company-defining problems with many stakeholders into clear strategies and executable plans.
  • You connect features directly to desired outcomes and key results to ensure we build the highest-impact work that ladders up to company-wide goals.
  • You prioritize ruthlessly and know how to make tradeoffs between speed, scale, and cost.
  • You break down large problems into smaller iterative milestones with clear success criteria that gate future phases of work, ensuring we don’t make over-sized investments relative to the value they deliver.
  • You are fluent with AI tools and demonstrate strong judgment about when and how to apply them both to ship artist-facing features and to drive your own and your team’s productivity.
  • You have hands-on experience building prototypes and proofs-of-concept with AI tooling, allowing you to validate ideas quickly and de-risk investments before committing engineering resources.
  • Expertise in translating artist and stakeholder needs into clear, concise product requirements, and managing workflow (ideally using JIRA/Confluence).
  • You operate as a multiplier, mentoring other PMs, setting standards, and lifting the quality of work around you.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, launching high-impact features from start to finish.
  • At least 3 years operating at a senior/lead level on a top-tier product team, ideally with a user base of independent creators or small business owners.
  • Demonstrated track record of setting product strategy for a significant area and driving measurable business outcomes.
  • Hands-on proficiency with AI tools you actively use them to prototype, accelerate research and decision-making, and build artist-facing capabilities.
  • Artist obsession with a strong bias for action.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to derive actionable insights.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience shipping AI/ML-powered features to production, with a clear understanding of their value, limitations, and responsible use.
  • Experience establishing AI-assisted workflows, reusable skills, or internal tooling that improved how a product team operates.
  • Confident using workflow management tools; experience with JIRA/Confluence preferred.
  • Comfortable digging into data, with hands-on experience using tools like Amplitude, Sigma, Mode, Tableau, etc.
  • You are a great team player who loves music and tech.
  • You are results-oriented, yet possess deep appreciation and sensitivity towards people, culture, and values.
  • You are persistent, but at the same time diplomatic and politically aware.
  • You are personable, smart, passionate, and optimistic, with a deeply pro-active, hands-on mentality.
  • You are excited about exploring entirely new business lines and opportunities, bringing your artist-first mentality wherever you go.
  • You hold yourself accountable and take great pride in your work, just like us.
  • Music Industry experience is preferred but not required.

Compensation

Salary Hiring Range: $195,000- $230,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits, and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. in some cases bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.).

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for NY/CA. As a company, we have a location-based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

title: Head of QRA - Full Time - CH
description:
About Us

Ikerian AG (formerly RetinAI Medical) is a fast-growing medical device software company headquartered in Bern, Switzerland. Our mission is to enable the right decisions sooner in healthcare, through transformative AI & data management solutions for disease screening and monitoring. Join our diverse team of entrepreneurs, developers, researchers, and commercial experts who are collectively shaping the future of healthcare.

Job Description

We are looking for a Head of Quality & Regulatory Affairs (QRA) to join our company in Bern, Switzerland. This role is pivotal in driving our internal operational maturity and ensuring global compliance across our expanding product portfolio. Following Ikerian’s acquisition by EssilorLuxottica, you will lead the evolution of the QRA department from a high-growth startup environment to a world-class subsidiary operation. You will oversee global product clearances for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), optimize our Quality Management System (QMS), and serve as a strategic partner to internal R&D, Research, and global sister companies like Heidelberg Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a global QRA team located across various time zones, establishing a supportive, high-performance team culture driven by clear accountability, structured goal-setting, and skills development.
  • Act as the legal Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) under EU MDR to ensure device conformity, keep technical documentation up to date, and oversee post-market surveillance and vigilance reporting obligations.
  • Develop and execute robust global regulatory strategies with an emphasis on securing and maintaining rapid market access via FDA submissions and CE-MDR compliance frameworks.
  • Govern and scale a world-class Quality Management System (QMS) ensuring continuous organizational readiness for ISO 13485 and the Medical Device Single Audit Program (MDSAP).
  • Serve as the primary corporate representative during all internal, Notified Body, partner, and health authority audits to ensure the continuous validation of corporate certifications.
  • Establish structured cross-functional alignment with R&D to seamlessly integrate design controls, risk management, and software lifecycles into early product development stages.
  • Partner with the IT Infrastructure and Security functions to support data privacy governance frameworks including GDPR and HIPAA compliance while aligning quality processes with emerging cybersecurity standards.

title: Senior Refinery Data Engineer
description:
Are you looking for a career in an inspiring, global environment where your expertise makes a difference? At Neste, you will be working for the world’s leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel.

We are looking for you,

Senior Refinery Data Engineer

to our Oil Products, Assets & Investments (A&I), Systems, Data & Metrics team. The job is located in Kilpilahti, Porvoo. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Systems, Data and Metrics is a team consisting of different IT technical and business process professionals. The team is responsible for owning A&I related IT solutions, their data and metrics/KPIs connected to them. The tasks in the team include evaluating development road maps, ensuring key user network operations, acting as focal point towards corporate IT and key supplier contacts and interaction with Porvoo refinery stakeholders for new requirements and KPIs.

Besides working closely within the team, in your role you will collaborate with A&I asset master data SMEs, plant investment projects and various leadership level stakeholders to ensure accurate data to base decisions on. You will be responsible for Porvoo refinery functional location, equipment and material master data. You will also act as a Business Solution Owner of SAP MDG and other related IT systems to secure efficient and transparent data flows from initial start of new investments all the way to decommissioning of assets. Together with your expertise, we can do meaningful work to drive Neste forward.

Reasons to join

We operate in an inspiring and evolving business environment as a global leader in renewable fuels. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day:

we care, we have courage, we cooperate.

We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment.

Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging.

In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi).

The job is located in Kilpilahti, Porvoo, which is about a 30-45 minute drive from the capital region. We organize free bus transportation to Kilpilahti for our employees from the capital region, Porvoo and the nearby areas.

More about the job

Your role in our team

Acting as the leading expert within the refinery master data area to ensure the integrity, availability, and usability of asset data (functional locations, equipment, and material) across the Oil Products business.

Owner of SAP MDG and related solutions development road map from A&I perspective, together with the network of peers in other Neste organisation branches.

Take full responsibility for the accuracy of functional location, equipment and material data objects within A&I.

Supporting Porvoo refinery as the leading specialist for functional location, equipment and material master data. Working alongside technical experts to guarantee the seamless integration of asset data requirements.

Development and ownership of discipline technology best practices and benchmark them against the industry standards.

The best combination to succeed in this role

Relevant technical degree, e.g. industrial/mechanical/automation engineer or similar. Preferably B.Eng or higher.

As a senior engineer role the successful candidate should have solid process industry and data management experience. This can be from e.g. design, maintenance and/or operations. Preferably a combination of these.

Solid knowhow on engineering data flows from tag reservation until decommissioning of the assets.

Relevant project experience and knowhow of the requirements in different project phases in an investment project.

Proven ability in complex data initiatives in an industrial environment.

Fluent spoken and written English, and conversational Finnish

Demonstrated skills to effectively collaborate and communicate with people of different backgrounds in complex matrix organizations.

Responsible attitude and safety-oriented mindset

Application deadline: October 25, 2026.

Neste (NESTE, Nasdaq Helsinki) is the world's leading producer of renewable diesel and sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), with production on three continents. Neste’s strategy focuses on growth in renewable fuels. The company’s renewables production capacity is expected to reach 6.8 million tons annually in 2027. Neste also produces high-quality oil products at its Porvoo refinery in Finland. The company has a network of nearly 1,000 fuel stations with expanding service offering, such as EV charging, in Finland and in the Baltics. Neste is included in many international indices for its sustainability performance. In 2025, Neste's revenue stood at EUR 19.0 billion. Read more: neste.com

title: Head of Design and Estimation (MEP)

They are looking to hire a Head of Design and Estimation in Lagos.


Job Summary
The Head of Design and Estimation is responsible for overseeing all company-wide MEP design development and material estimation activities, ensuring accurate, compliant, and competitive technical submissions across all projects.

Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and overall direction for the design and estimation functions across all MEP disciplines, ensuring alignment with company objectives, project requirements, and client expectations.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to design engineers and estimators, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and continuous improvement within the team.

  • Identify project risks related to design during tender and pre-construction phases and develop mitigation strategies.

  • Liaise with clients, consultants, and authorities to clarify technical requirements, resolve design issues, and support approvals.

  • Support contract negotiations by providing technical clarifications and value engineering proposals.

  • Continuously review market trends and new technologies to improve design efficiency, accuracy of estimates, and overall project competitiveness.

Job Requirement

  • Minimum of a first degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent, from a reputable institution.

  • Minimum of 10 years’ proven experience in MEP design and estimation, with strong exposure to HVAC systems (VRF and chilled water), plumbing, and fire protection systems.

  • Strong working knowledge of AutoCAD; experience with other design and estimation software is an advantage.

  • Experience supporting tendering processes, technical submissions, and value engineering.

  • Proven leadership experience, with evidence of successfully managing design and estimation teams.

  • Ability to independently design and estimate MEP systems, including the preparation of full calculation packages and drawings.

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong technical and analytical skills, with high attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordination with internal teams, clients, and consultants.

  • Proven leadership and team management capabilities.

  • Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project cost drivers.

  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tenders and projects simultaneously.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines while maintaining quality and accuracy.

title: Kirketjener i Randers
description:
Attraktiv stilling som kirketjener

Da en af vores dygtige kirketjenere er blevet optaget på videregående uddannelse, søger vi en aktiv og engageret medarbejder til en fast stilling som kirketjener ved Sct. Peders Kirke, Randers. Vi ønsker stillingen besat pr. 1. februar 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er på 22 timer.

Vi er en meget aktiv kirke med mange forskellige aktiviteter i løbet af ugen ud over gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger, bl.a. babysalmesang, kor, tirsdagscafe, Kreativ Mandag, Café Kaffekoppen mv. Du vil blive en meget vigtig brik i at få alt det praktiske til at spille. Du vil få stor indflydelse på din egen hverdag, og det vigtigste for os er, at du har blik for opgaverne, så de praktiske ting fungerer. Da vi har rigtig mange aktiviteter – og derfor mange mennesker i lokalerne i løbet af ugen, vil rengøring fylde en stor del af din arbejdstid. Ud over kirken har vi to sognehuse, Nr. 47 og Sct. Peders Hus.

Vi har to kirketjenere, - en på 29 timer, og dig på 22 timer. Vi har også mange frivillige, der hjælper til, så det er vigtigt, at du har gode samarbejdsevner.

Det er vigtigt, at du har gode samarbejdsevner, men du skal også kunne arbejde selvstændigt. Du skal have lyst til at gøre rent, og det er vigtigt, at du selv kan se hvilke opgaver, der skal prioriteres – særligt når der er tryk på.

Du skal være imødekommende, serviceminded og ansvarsbevidst og være både blæksprutte og kirkens ansigt overfor de mange forskellige mennesker, som kommer i kirken.

Det er vigtigt, at du har forståelse for det kirkelige liv og for Folkekirkens betydning og rolle i lokalsamfundet.

Ved Sct. Peders Kirke er der ansat 2 præster, 2 organister, 2 kordegne, 2 kirketjenere og 2 kirke- og kulturmedarbejdere. Du vil blive en del af en særdeles engageret medarbejdergruppe, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor loyalitet og ansvarlighed er kerneværdier.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:
- Rengøring i både kirken, Nr. 47 og Sct. Peders Hus
- Indkøb og klargøring til møder og øvrige arrangementer
- Oprydning og opvask
- Kirketjeneste ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
- Pasning af udendørsarealer i mindre omfang

Derudover vil der kunne forekomme øvrige forefaldende kirketjeneropgaver.

Ansættelse sker ved Sct. Peders Sogns Menighedsråd beliggende Fabersvej 41, 8900 Randers C.
Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på .

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kirketjenere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet kirketjener.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.667,02 kr. – 408.841,08 kr. (nutidskroner).
Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.230,62 kr. (nutidskroner).
OK tillæg på 1.400,52 kr. (nutidskroner) pr. år.
Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.
Løn, OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til kontaktperson Benedikte Jarlstrøm på telefonnummer 2445 9667/mail: 8182fortrolig@sogn.dk.

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag sendes til Sct. Peders Sogns Menighedsråd på mail til: 8182fortrolig@sogn.dk. Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde senest den 18. november 2026 kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at finde sted i uge 49.
Menighedsrådet kan oplyse, at der vil blive indhentet referencer.

title: Protein Engineer
description:
Melody is an early-stage focused research organization engineering continuous molecular monitoring technology and designing closed-loop interventions for human health. We leverage protein engineering, medical device engineering, and physiology modeling. As a FRO, we uniquely bridge blue-sky science and hardcore manufacturing and pioneer new applications.

We are a nonprofit startup based in Pasadena, founded by scientists and engineers from Janelia and Caltech and incubated by Convergent Research. Our goal is to produce public goods: biosensors, devices, datasets, protocols, and tools that help launch a broader field of real-time molecular medicine.

About the role: we are hiring a protein engineer to create new biosensors composed of allosteric switches, signal transduction motifs (e.g., linkers), reporter proteins, site-specific chemical modifications, and bioelectronic interfaces. The engineer will design new constructs, guide wet lab screening, and work with the hardware team to select performant constructs. You will also mentor and manage junior scientists and work with Melody’s outside academic collaborators and CRO partners.

You may excel in this role if you enjoy creating new molecules from scratch and working with target product profiles. Ideal candidates will be able to manage both open-ended searches in protein space while working with the engineering team on performance optimization.

What success looks like:

In 3 months - set up de novo design and directed evolution workflows for our foundry.

In 6 months - design and validate your own biosensor scaffolds against ions, small molecules, and peptides.

In 15 months - integrate experimental feedback from devices and revamp design workflow.

Required Qualifications:

  • Strength in one self-identified track: (a) experimental-first - where your strengths and approaches rely on mining naturally occurring motifs, using chemical intuition to design sensors, and experimental testing to effectively select candidates OR (b) computation-first where your strengths and approaches rely on de novo design methods (reducing the number and breadth of experimental loops).

  • Structural biology and biophysics competency related to optical and electrophysiological measurements.

  • PhD in a relevant science and engineering field with demonstrated strong independent ideation and execution or BS/MS with extensive industry experience (> 5 years).

  • Quantitative judgment for designing experiments under real-world constraints, matching roadmap goals to instrument capabilities and lab throughput.

  • Demonstrated precision in experimental work and scientific project management.

  • Strong technical communication skills across the relevant scientific fields and teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years industry experience in protein design and selection.

  • Ability to write custom scripts for data analysis and interfacing with lab instruments.

  • Working ability in both experimental methods and computational tools for protein design.

  • Conceptual command of allostery and protein dynamics.

  • Conceptual command of the electronic nose field.

  • 2+ years of team management and mentoring experience. We are especially interested in those with a track record of coordinating across chemists, materials scientists, hardware engineers, software/data scientists, vendors, and academic collaborators.

Melody FRO, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender-identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. description:
GameSim is a game development studio that partners with clients to build games across PC/console and a range of art styles. We care about craftsmanship, collaboration, and shipping work we’re proud to put our names on. If you love building environments and believable spaces we’d like to meet you. Our headquarters is based in Orlando, FL!

Talent Pipeline Posting Notice
Please note that this posting is not tied to an immediate vacancy. We are proactively building a pipeline of qualified candidates in anticipation of potential hiring needs over the coming months. Applications will be reviewed and retained for future consideration as opportunities arise.

We are looking for an Environment Artist / Generalist with strong hands-on art skills, solid technical judgment, and the potential to grow into broader lead responsibilities over time.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both creating high-quality 3D art and helping teams work more clearly, consistently, and efficiently. Depending on the project, this person may contribute directly to asset creation, world building, scene assembly, feedback, task breakdowns, workflow documentation, quality reviews, and cross-studio collaboration.

Because our projects can vary widely in style, scope, platform, and client needs, we are looking for an adaptable artist with a strong art eye, a practical production mindset, and the ability to help translate creative direction into actionable work for other artists.

This is a hands-on production role with opportunities to support team alignment, mentor other artists, improve workflows, and grow toward lead-level responsibilities.

This role offers flexible work options, including remote, hybrid or in-office arrangements.

Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality 3D environment art, props, modular assets, materials, set dressing, and world-building content across a variety of visual styles.
  • Work from concept art, reference, style guides, blockouts, client direction, or incomplete/vague creative briefs to produce clear and polished results.
  • Build, assemble, and integrate assets and environments in Unreal Engine, with attention to composition, readability, performance, and technical requirements.
  • Support the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, material creation, optimization, engine integration, and final polish.
  • Review artwork from internal teammates, partner studios, or external vendors and provide clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
  • Help translate broad client or project feedback into specific tasks, priorities, notes, and acceptance criteria that artists can execute against.
  • Assist with maintaining visual consistency across assets, scenes, and artists by helping define quality bars, style expectations, and review standards.
  • Collaborate with art directors, leads, producers, technical artists, designers, engineers, and artists across multiple studios and time zones.
  • Help identify production risks early, including unclear direction, workflow gaps, quality issues, technical constraints, or schedule concerns.
  • Contribute to workflow and pipeline improvements that help the team work more efficiently and consistently.
  • Document processes, best practices, feedback, and workflow guidance when needed using tools such as Confluence, Miro, or Jira.
  • Balance visual quality, production efficiency, and performance requirements while supporting the needs of each project.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a 3D Environment Artist, Generalist, World Artist, or similar role in games or real-time production.
  • At least one shipped game or comparable real-time interactive project.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality environment art, world building, prop creation, materials, and/or scene assembly.
  • Strong artistic eye for form, composition, lighting, material definition, scale, visual hierarchy, and style consistency.
  • Ability to work across different visual styles, from realistic to stylized, depending on project needs.
  • Experience creating both individual assets and assembled environments/scenes.
  • Solid understanding of the full environment art pipeline, including modeling, UV layout, baking, texturing, materials, optimization, and engine implementation.
  • Professional experience with Unreal Engine.
  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, Photoshop.
  • Practical understanding of real-time performance considerations, including LODs, draw calls, texel density, texture memory, collision, lightmaps, shaders/material complexity, scene organization, and asset budgets.
  • Strong communication skills, especially when giving feedback, clarifying direction, documenting decisions, or breaking down complex problems.
  • Ability to take vague or high-level direction and turn it into clear, actionable work.
  • Comfortable collaborating with artists, leads, producers, and cross-discipline partners.
  • Able to give and receive feedback professionally, clearly, and constructively.
  • Strong ownership, follow-through, and problem-solving ability.
  • Interest in growing into broader leadership responsibilities over time.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience mentoring artists, reviewing work, or informally supporting lead-level responsibilities.
  • Experience working with outsourcing, co-development, partner studios, or external vendors.
  • Experience collaborating with teams across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Experience providing feedback through written notes, paintovers, drawovers, video reviews, live calls, or structured review documents.
  • Proficiency with common production tools such as Perforce, Jira, Miro, and Confluence.
  • Experience helping define style guides, quality bars, workflow documentation, or art review standards.
  • Experience breaking down client feedback into Jira tasks, art notes, production plans, or acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with procedural workflows, Houdini, Blueprint, Python, scripting, or tool-assisted content creation.
  • Experience with optimization passes, performance profiling, memory budgets, or platform-specific art constraints.
  • Experience with both realistic and stylized production art.
  • Experience in multiple engines or real-time pipelines.
  • Experience working directly with clients or helping support client-facing reviews.

Portfolio Requirements

Please include a portfolio that clearly demonstrates your environment art and/or generalist capabilities.

Strong portfolios should include:

  • Finished 3D environments, scenes, props, or world-building examples.
  • Examples rendered or captured in a real-time engine, preferably Unreal Engine.
  • Breakdowns showing your process, including blockout, modeling, UVs, baking, texturing, materials, set dressing, lighting, and final integration where applicable.
  • Examples that show your ability to work across different visual styles.
  • Examples of modular kits, reusable asset systems, material workflows, or production-friendly environment pipelines.
  • Any examples that show technical problem solving, optimization, performance-aware decisions, or efficient workflows.
  • If showing team-created work, please clearly explain what you personally contributed.
  • Nice to have: examples of feedback, mentorship, documentation, workflow improvements, style matching, or before/after improvements you helped guide.
  • Nice to have: written context explaining the goal of the work, constraints, tools used, your role, and any production challenges you helped solve.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is not just a strong artist, but someone who naturally thinks about how the whole team succeeds.

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Care about making great-looking art and making the process better for the team.
  • Enjoy solving production problems, not just completing assigned assets.
  • Can look at a scene or asset and identify what is working, what is not, and how to improve it.
  • Communicate feedback in a way that is clear, respectful, and useful.
  • Can help artists understand not just what to change, but why it matters.
  • Are comfortable adapting to different clients, art styles, pipelines, and project needs.
  • Have the judgment to balance quality, speed, technical constraints, and team bandwidth.
  • Are interested in growing toward lead responsibilities while remaining hands-on in production.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

title: Station Agent
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Station Agent position ensures that all Amerijet customers are treated in a professional, courteous and timely manner whether being handled in person, over the phone or via email. Processes and records all shipping information for air freight services in the Amerijet Smart Kargo system respectively. Oversees the operations of the station to ensure shipment and accounting accuracy, reliability and overall quality of service.

Job Responsibilities include the following, but not limited to:

  • Works in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Provides quotations, billing, tracking, and schedule information to customers as requested.
  • Reviews all information and documents and corrects any discrepancy.
  • Tracks all warehouse inventories, along with setting up local pick-ups and deliveries.
  • Enters warehouse receipts for all freight accepted for both air and ocean.
  • Ensures all POD entries are made timely and accurately.
  • Assists customers by processing documents, receiving payment, and depositing cash in the safe.
  • Reconciliation of daily revenue and back up to all accounting functions as required.
  • Correctly labels freight as required prior to shipping.
  • Scans freight for tracking purposes prior to loading trucks.
  • Ensures cleanliness of facility for both employees and customers.
  • Ensures the overall operation of the station is in compliance with Amerijet procedures and standards.
  • Off-loads and loads trucks with freight using a fork-lift.
  • Ensures that the work area is clean and void of hazards or safety issues throughout the station.
  • Performs daily/weekly/monthly/annual inventory as directed by management.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Performance Standards/Measurements:

  • Always exhibits a professional demeanor.
  • Works effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Interacts effectively with colleagues and customers.
  • Demonstrates ability and resourcefulness.
  • Proactive and timely in problem-solving.
  • Recognizes priorities and organizes workload accordingly.
  • Maintains communications with all involved parties on a project.
  • Ensures that work product is accurate, thorough and neat.
  • Maintains accurate and concise records/files.
  • Consistently follows Company policies and procedures (including governmental and safety) and departmental Standard Operating Procedures.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • High School diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
  • A self-starter is required, must be able to work effectively with minimal to no supervision.
  • Administration skills and proficient computer skills are mandatory.
  • Min. 1 year of warehouse experience is preferred.
  • Prior Fork-lift driving experience is preferred.
  • Prior customer service and conflict resolution experience is a plus.
  • Prior airline/freight forwarding experience is preferred.
  • Identification of HAZMAT Materials and knowledge of proper handling (Preferably).
  • Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos; ability to write simple correspondence.
  • Ability to read, speak and understand English.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide into all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small groups' situations to customers, client and other employees of the organization.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding carrying out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Must be able to accomplish computerized transactions in PMI, Microsoft Excel, Word, Access, UNIX, Lotus Notre and Internet Explorer.
  • Possess and maintain a valid Driver License and a driving record from the state of your primary residence that meets Amerijet’s insurance standards.
