title: Sr. Specialist – CICD Automation
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

At Scout Motors, you don't just design vehicles- you shape the future of the road. Our Engineering team is where bold ideas meet rigorous execution, building machines that are as durable and capable as the people who drive them. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant minds across disciplines, turning complex challenges into elegant, scalable solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, performance, and user experience. This is a place where your fingerprints are found on metal – where what you design gets built, driven, and remembered. If you're hungry to engineer something that matters, Scout Motors is where that ambition finds its highest gear.

We are seeking a highly motivated CI/CD Automation Engineer to develop and scale automation infrastructure for secondary ECU software integration and full vehicle software packaging within a Software Defined Vehicle (SDV) ecosystem. This role focuses on enabling reliable, secure, and high-velocity software delivery pipelines across distributed vehicle systems, supporting everything from individual ECU builds to complete vehicle software release packages and OTA deployment workflows. The ideal candidate has strong experience in embedded systems, DevOps automation, release engineering, and automotive software integration in fast-paced environments. Role is the backbone of software delivery for vehicle platforms ensuring ECU SW packages are reliably built, traceable, configurable, and deployable at scale enabling faster iteration, safer releases, and seamless integration across complex EV systems.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable CI/CD pipelines for secondary ECU software and full vehicle software releases.
  • Automate build, integration, validation, and packaging workflows across multiple ECU domains.
  • Develop orchestration frameworks for incremental builds, multi-ECU dependency management, artifact generation, software versioning, release traceability
  • Optimize pipeline execution time, scalability, and reliability.
  • Automate vehicle manifest generation, package signing, dependency validation, binary compatibility checks, OTA release bundle creation
  • Support coordinated software releases across body ECUs, gateway ECUs, infotainment, ADAS/Autonomy modules, connectivity systems
  • Build release gating and approval workflows for production vehicle software.
  • Integrate automated validation into CI pipelines including unit tests, integration tests, SIL/HIL testing, regression suites, flash validation, vehicle bring-up checks
  • Develop automation around containerized build environments, cross-compilation toolchains, ECU flashing tools, vehicle simulation frameworks
  • Manage versioning strategy, release branching and tagging and dependency management across ECU software stacks
  • Ensure alignment and delivery between ECU releases and vehicle-level integration milestones
  • Enable reproducible builds with traceability from commit → artifact → vehicle
  • Design and manage artifact storage and distribution systems: firmware binaries, calibration data, configuration files
  • Implement version-controlled artifact repositories and metadata tracking
  • Ensure secure and reliable delivery of artifacts to integration, vehicle builds, OTA systems and manufacturing pipelines
  • Develop tooling to generate custom ECU builds (feature flags, configuration variants, debug/release modes) and vehicle-level software packages (multi-ECU bundles) for on-demand builds for specific test or vehicle configurations

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.
  • This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Master’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 10+ yrs. of experience
  • Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architecture and ECU-level software stacks, automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) and diagnostic communication tools
  • Expert knowledge of Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, and Artifactory. ALM/PLM proficiency in Siemens Polarion, IBM DOORS Next Gen, or PTC Windchill.
  • Strong understanding, development and verification of plant and control models in MATLAB/Simulink for execution in hardware in the loop test environment, dSpace control desk and automation desk
  • Strong understanding of 1st principles in Engineering, result/solution oriented.
  • Familiarity with SW for embedded systems, EE systems and architecture
  • Familiarity with A2B, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, LVDS communication protocols and Vehicle Network tools, such as CANalyzer, CANoe, etc.‚
  • Expertise with complex problem solving, data analysis, access/interpret/drive results with extended teams.
  • Knowledge of Automotive design and development process, system requirements, and general engineering best practices

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $140,000.00 - $170,000.00

  • To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

DevOps & Infrastructure

title: Sr. Specialist – OTA Integration
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

At Scout Motors, you don't just design vehicles- you shape the future of the road. Our Engineering team is where bold ideas meet rigorous execution, building machines that are as durable and capable as the people who drive them. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant minds across disciplines, turning complex challenges into elegant, scalable solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, performance, and user experience. This is a place where your fingerprints are found on metal – where what you design gets built, driven, and remembered. If you're hungry to engineer something that matters, Scout Motors is where that ambition finds its highest gear.

We are seeking a highly technical engineer to lead integration testing and validation of OTA (Over-the-Air) update systems on the vehicle side. This role focuses on deep system-level validation across ECUs, bootloaders, diagnostics, and vehicle networks, ensuring OTA updates execute reliably under all real-world conditions. Candidate will work hands-on with vehicles, HIL systems, and embedded software to validate end-to-end update flows, failure recovery, and cross-ECU coordination, with ownership of technical validation and release sign-off. This person will validate how all vehicle systems implement OTA robustly on the platform —directly shaping the reliability, scalability, and performance of the entire vehicle platform. Define and ensure OTA updates work flawlessly under real-world conditions preventing vehicle failures, enabling continuous software delivery, and protecting customer trust in software-defined EV platforms.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • Execute and validate full OTA workflows, update trigger → package download → verification → flashing → ECU reboot → post-update validation
  • Test across single ECU updates, multi-ECU coordinated updates along with delta and full-image updates
  • Validate update sequencing and dependency management across ECUs
  • Test OTA interactions with ECU bootloaders, flash drivers and memory partitions
  • Validate A/B partitioning and rollback mechanisms, flash integrity and checksum validation
  • Validate version management, compatibility checks and debug failures at firmware and memory level
  • Perform OTA-related validation using UDS (ISO 14229) over CAN and DoIP
  • Develop tools for OTA test orchestration, automated flashing and validation, log parsing and anomaly detection
  • Validate diagnostic services during OTA request download / transfer data / transfer exit and ECU reset and session transitions
  • Ensure correct DTC behavior during and after updates, debug protocol-level issues (timeouts, negative responses, sequence errors)
  • Design and execute edge-case scenarios power loss during flashing, ignition/arbitration cycles mid-update and reliability with network interruptions (packet loss, latency spikes)
  • Validate recovery strategies, rollback behavior, ECU reprogramming resilience to ensure no-brick behavior for safety-critical ECUs
  • Design scalable regression test suites for consistent behavior across simulated and real-world environments across SIL, HIL and vehicle infrastructure
  • Analyze large-scale CAN/Ethernet logs for intermittent failures, cross-ECU timing mismatches, system-level integration issues
  • Own vehicle-level regression test planning, drive root cause analysis of cross-domain issues and help support integration war-room activities during DV/PV builds.

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.
  • This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 10+ yrs. of experience
  • Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architecture and ECU-level software stacks, automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) and diagnostic communication tools
  • Expert knowledge of Jira, GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, and Artifactory. ALM/PLM proficiency in Siemens Polarion, IBM DOORS Next Gen, or PTC Windchill.
  • Strong understanding, development and verification of plant and control models in MATLAB/Simulink for execution in hardware in the loop test environment, dSpace control desk and automation desk
  • Strong understanding of 1st principles in Engineering, result/solution oriented.
  • Familiarity with SW for embedded systems, EE systems and architecture
  • Familiarity with A2B, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, LVDS communication protocols and Vehicle Network tools, such as CANalyzer, CANoe, etc.‚
  • Expertise with complex problem solving, data analysis, access/interpret/drive results with extended teams.
  • Knowledge of Automotive design and development process, system requirements, and general engineering best practices

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $140,000.00 - $170,000.00

Internal leveling code: IC8

Notice to applicants:

  • To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.
  • Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

description:

title: Spacecraft Operations Engineer Pipeline
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems team is responsible for every satellite and satellite component made by Rocket Lab: from complete satellites destined for missions to the Moon and Mars, to the individual components and subsystems that make up a satellite like solar panels, flight software, reaction wheels and star trackers, separation systems, radios, and more. Our Space Systems team is made up of engineers, technicians, and designers who design, create, and put together our own satellites for missions across the commercial, government, and defence sectors, or who build and assemble satellite hardware and software that supports other satellite missions.

SPACECRAFT OPERATIONS ENGINEER

Based at our Auckland Production Complex, a Spacecraft Operations Engineer will take ownership of spacecraft operations across a diverse and growing fleet - from LEO constellations to deep space exploration missions. You won’t just operate spacecraft - you’ll design how they’re operated, shaping automation, software, and mission success from concept to re-entry.

You’ll collaborate with world-class engineers across propulsion, flight software, GNC, and mission design - turning ambitious ideas into reality, fast.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Command and operate spacecraft with automation at the core
  • Develop and test ground and flight software for long-term missions
  • Build robust operational scripts and telemetry/FDIR configurations
  • Lead validation using simulation tools (HITL, flatsat)
  • Support spacecraft through integration, testing, launch, and on-orbit life
  • Drive continuous improvement across systems, processes, and performance

WHAT SETS YOU APART:

  • You’re not just technically strong - you’re decisive, curious, and solutions-focused.
  • You tackle complex engineering problems and find a path forward
  • You own your work end-to-end and deliver under pressure
  • You communicate clearly, challenge respectfully, and collaborate deeply
  • You think in systems, balance risk, and optimise for real-world outcomes

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace, Systems, Software engineering or other engineering degree
  • 3+ years of experience in any of the following: space mission design, satellite subsystems, ground systems, or spacecraft operations
  • Background in mission design, satellite subsystems, ground systems, or spacecraft operations/command
  • Familiarity with Linux systems and software development experience, such as Python, C++, or other high-level languages
  • Strong understanding of spacecraft systems (ADCS, power, comms, C&DH, thermal)
  • Solid grasp of orbital mechanics, space environment, and dynamics
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, multi-priority environments

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Postgraduate degree in Aerospace Engineering
  • Experience in spacecraft ops, satellite design, or ground systems
  • Familiarity with modern dev tools (Git, CI/CD, cloud)
  • Hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) testing experience

This isn’t just a job. It’s a chance to help build spacecraft that go further, operate smarter, and achieve more than ever before.

Ready to launch your career into orbit? Apply now and help us shape the future of space.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com.This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations.

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join team Aqueduct, a team building our data platform for powering large-scale cross-platform advertising. Our ideal candidate is a professional who has experience in the domain of data engineering, and knows how to design, implement and maintain data storages and pipelines using industry standard tools.

For our customers, ensuring their data is available and composable can:

  • unlock the potential of creative automation with image and video templates
  • power agentic workflows that utilise the data
  • allow analysis of the relationship between product data and ad performance.

Being able to sync our customers’ product data across multiple advertising channels consistently and with minimal delays ensures that:

  • the ads consumers see have the latest information
  • products that are out of stock are not advertised
  • regulatory requirements are met

The team currently has a backend written in Ruby on Rails, and we own small parts of the frontend written in TypeScript and React. We’re moving our data systems from Ruby to a language and architecture better suited for the workload and capable of scaling with our growth. We're looking for an experienced engineer to join the team and contribute to the build and design of this new platform using the right tools for the job.

What You Will Do

  • Build a large scale data storage and processing system that needs to process billions of records per day
  • Contribute to the architecture and engineering excellence inside the team by collaborating with other engineers
  • Collaborate with stakeholders from across the organization: engineering, product and business
  • Participate in defining and monitoring SLAs, and follow SRE best practices to ensure the stability and availability of the system
  • Build APIs for internal and external consumers of the data
  • Affect the ROI for billions of dollars in ad spend

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years of industry experience
  • Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, Scala and/or Java)
  • Some experience with data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse)
  • Familiarity with streaming systems (e.g Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Experience with SQL and some RDBMS (PostgreSQL, Citus, etc.)
  • Experience contributing to large-scale data systems
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails is considered a plus
  • Ability to work in a hybrid capacity from our Helsinki office 3 days a week

What We Offer You

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can advance your career. Here, you'll find:

An Inclusive Global Culture: Join a team of over 750 Smartlies, representing more than 60 nationalities across 24 locations in 13 countries. We cultivate a culture built on trust, transparency, and open feedback, where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged.

Global Impact: Contribute to a company making a global impact, directly influencing our customers' success and business growth.

Focus on Wellbeing: We prioritize your health with healthcare packages, mental health services, and a commitment to work-life balance through paid holidays and family leave.

Comprehensive Rewards: Benefit from equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.

Flexible Hybrid Workplace: Experience a hybrid work model, balancing office collaboration with remote work, and the option to work abroad for up to 30 days annually.

Apply Now and Build Your Future with Smartly!

Curious what it’s like to work at Smartly? Visit our Careers page to see how we grow, collaborate, and make impact together.

#LI-HYBRID

About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

title: Business Travel Consultant - German - Remote
description:

At Navan, our mission is to make travel seamless and empowering, so travelers can focus on being there, not getting there. Our Travel Experience team is at the heart of this mission!

As a key member of our fast-growing Travel Experience team, you'll support our users’ travel needs directly. You’ll take ownership of customer satisfaction by resolving issues, communicating effectively, and collaborating with internal teams to clear any obstacles for travelers — all while delivering an exceptional customer experience. As our frontline, you’ll provide valuable feedback to our product, design, and engineering teams to enhance our customer-facing and internal platforms. This exciting role allows you to impact daily operations, traveler experiences, and product development directly.

NOTE: Candidates must reside in Portugal for consideration, or willing to relocate. Please submit all applications in English.

  • Quickly assess customer needs, urgency, and preferences
  • Accurately handle hotel, flight, car, and rail bookings
  • Guide customers in self-service options on the Navan platform and app
  • Respond promptly, meeting SLA expectations
  • Follow company and customer policies, ensuring global compliance
  • Give feedback to stakeholders on goal progress and key processes

  • Language: Fluency in English and German - Mandatory fluency in both languages
  • Customer Service: Background in contact center or customer-facing roles

title: Real-Time Systems Engineer
description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

We are seeking a talented and motivated Software Developer to join our Robotics & AI Software team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work closely with experienced automation and software engineers to develop and implement innovative algorithms for task and motion planning plus computer vision in robotic systems. As a key member of our team, you will contribute to the design, development, and testing of software solutions aimed at enhancing the efficiency and reliability of robotic software algorithms. This involves symbolic task planning, robot kinematics, collision detection, optimization, and computer vision.

The Role

  • Develop and maintain software development best practices to ensure high-quality code, efficient testing, and timely releases.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure that our software integrates seamlessly with other software products.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to understand project requirements and contribute to the development of software solutions for robot task and motion planning.
  • Design, implement, and optimize algorithms within our planning framework, leveraging your programming skills and understanding of robotics principles.
  • Assist in the integration and testing of computer vision software to ensure robustness and performance in real-world scenarios.
  • Document your work, including code, algorithms, user manuals, and procedures, to support knowledge sharing and future development efforts.
  • Stay updated on advancements in robot planning algorithms and technologies, and contribute fresh ideas and insights to the team.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Robotics, or related field with 5+ years of professional experience.
  • Proficient in programming languages such as C++ and Python.
  • Strong knowledge of data-structures, algorithms, and design pattern.
  • Fundamental understanding of industrial robotics including manipulator kinematics & dynamics, robot trajectory generation, and communications protocols.
  • Expertise with search algorithms, optimization methods, and constraint satisfaction.
  • Experience with open source robotic planning and manipulation software packages such as MoveIt and ROS.
  • Knowledge of unit-testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including product managers & owners, engineers, and internal customers

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, or related field with 3+ years of professional experience.
  • Understanding of computer vision libraries such as OpenCV and PCL.
  • Experience using programming languages such as C#, TypeScript.
  • Explored using Generative AI in robotics.
  • Strong publication record and/or open source contributions in the field of robotics.

Work Environment

  • Hybrid

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at levels E05 - E06 as evaluated through our interview process.

  • E05 / Senior: $141,380 -$194.390

  • E06 / Staff: $163,270 - $224,500

Pay Range
$141,380—$224,500 USD

What We Offer:

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
  • Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
  • Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. title: Researcher – Agentic Interaction Engineering
description:
Huawei Canada has an immediate 12-month contract opening for a Researcher.

About the team:

The Huawei Human-Machine Interaction Lab unites global researchers, engineers, and designers to redefine human technology relationships through user centered, hands on research. We focus on agentic AI and multimodal interaction (voice, touch, vision, gesture) across smartphones, wearables, and emerging devices—advancing agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and intuitive human-AI interfaces. By tightly integrating sensing, algorithms, and systems, our prototype driven work ships directly to products, enabling seamless task delegation and human AI collaboration at scale.

About the job:

  • Design and implement agentic applications that allow AI to dynamically interact with external tools, APIs, and computer environments.

  • Experiment with and implement novel methodologies and techniques (e.g., harness engineering) to enhance task execution, leveraging the latest advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous agent systems.

  • Work closely with AI researchers, engineers, and UX/UI designers on projects exploring novel human-AI interactions.

  • Apply strong problem-solving skills to develop efficient solutions for complex technical challenges, including agent reliability, context-window management, and error recovery.

  • Evaluate and improve the performance, token efficiency, and reasoning latency of agentic interactions, ensuring they meet strict performance standards and user needs.

  • Stay informed about the latest trends and advancements in autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, and human-AI teaming, and suggest innovative ideas for agent self-improvement projects.

The total target annual compensation (based on 2,080 hours per year) ranges from $106,000 - $156,000 depending on education, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Requirements

About the ideal candidate:

  • PhD, Master, or Bachelor graduates in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong programming skills in high-level languages essential for AI development (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++).

  • Familiarity with algorithms, data structures, LLM APIs, and prompt engineering.

  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to learn quickly and adapt to the rapidly evolving landscape of AI technologies.

  • Passion for artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and creating next-generation interfaces designed specifically for human-AI collaboration.

  • Understanding of agentic frameworks, function calling/tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, or experience managing agent gateways in Linux environments is considered as an asset.

Additional Information:

Huawei Canada is committed to a fair, inclusive, and accessible recruitment process. If you require accommodation during any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

All applications for this position are reviewed directly by our hiring team, we do not use artificial intelligence tools to screen or select candidates.

title: Sr. Specialist - AI Automation & Testing
description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

At Scout Motors, you don't just design vehicles- you shape the future of the road. Our Engineering team is where bold ideas meet rigorous execution, building machines that are as durable and capable as the people who drive them. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with brilliant minds across disciplines, turning complex challenges into elegant, scalable solutions that meet the highest standards of safety, performance, and user experience. This is a place where your fingerprints are found on metal – where what you design gets built, driven, and remembered. If you're hungry to engineer something that matters, Scout Motors is where that ambition finds its highest gear.

The EE/SW Integration Manager at the OEM level owns and builds the infrastructure that enables rapid, reliable iteration of vehicle software and electronics. You’ll work close to the vehicle—developing automation, integration pipelines, and test systems that connect embedded software running on ECUs with cloud-based development workflows. This role goes beyond architecture compliance and focuses on feature behavior, timing performance, system robustness, drivability impact, and cross-domain interaction quality. This role bridges embedded systems, software integration, and development infrastructure to enable efficient, scalable, and reliable engineering workflows. Work directly with MSTs, software engineers, systems engineers, validation teams, and suppliers to ensure robust delivery.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

  • End-to-End Toolchain architect responsible to develop and implement toolchains spanning: Code commit → build → ECU flashing → vehicle/HIL testing → data logging → analysis
  • Build ML models for test case prioritization, failure prediction, and intelligent test selection (e.g., using historical pass/fail, code churn, coverage)
  • Implement anomaly detection on logs, CAN traces, and system telemetry (e.g., Isolation Forest, LSTM, or statistical methods)
  • Develop NLP pipelines for automated log triage and defect classification
  • Integrate AI modules into pipelines using Jenkins / GitLab CI / GitHub Actions
  • Orchestrate workflows with Docker + Kubernetes for scalable test execution
  • Implement event-driven automation (e.g., build triggers, test triggers, auto triage)
  • Embed quality gates based on AI predictions (e.g., block/allow release based on risk scoring)
  • Automate ECU flashing (UDS, bootloaders) across benches and vehicles and OTA package generation and deployment workflows with integrating HIL rigs into automated pipelines.
  • Automate smoke validation pipelines post-integration with real-time analytics
  • Support pre-release (e.g., Pilot Hall / factory SW integration) with AI-based readiness scoring
  • Align AI automation with DVP, sprint cycles, and regression frameworks
  • Provide dashboards for release health, defect leakage, and test effectiveness
  • Inept to build custom automation frameworks as applicable to the platform to drive automation roll-out and adaptation
  • Build and maintain SIL/HIL framework, vehicle-level regression systems, automate test orchestration across multiple environments (bench, dyno, fleet vehicles).
  • Create pipelines for ingesting and analyzing vehicle telemetry and test data.
  • Develop tools for log parsing (CAN traces, diagnostic logs), real-time monitoring and alerting
  • Hands-on experience with vehicle communication protocols: CAN (DBC, UDS), LIN, Automotive Ethernet
  • Experience building CI/CD systems, familiarity with Linux-based development environments.

Location & Travel Expectations:

  • This role may be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.
  • This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.
  • Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field with 8+ yrs. Of experience
  • Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architecture and ECU-level software stacks, automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet), UDS diagnostics (ISO 14229) and diagnostic communication tools
  • Expert knowledge of GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, and Artifactory. ALM/PLM proficiency in Codebeamer, Siemens Polarion, IBM DOORS Next Gen, or PTC Windchill.
  • Programming: Python (advanced), SQL, Bash
  • ML/AI: n8n, Pinecone, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch, time-series & anomaly detection with CI/CD expertise in Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions
  • Containers/Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding, development and scaling of vehicle toolchain, data systems across fleet for development and analytics.
  • Strong understanding of 1st principles in Engineering, result/solution oriented.
  • Familiarity with SW for embedded systems, EE systems and architecture
  • Familiarity with A2B, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, LIN, LVDS communication protocols and Vehicle Network tools, such as CANalyzer, CANoe, etc.‚
  • Expertise with complex problem solving, data analysis, access/interpret/drive results with extended teams.
  • Knowledge of Automotive design and development process, system requirements, and general engineering best practices

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

  • Competitive insurance including:
    • Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans
  • 401(k) program with:
    • An employer match and immediate vesting
  • Generous Paid Time Off including:
    • 20 days planned PTO, as accrued
    • 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
    • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
    • Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $140,000.00 - $170,000.00

Internal leveling code: IC8

Notice to applicants:

  • To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  • Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.
  • Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

title: JUNIOR CREATIVE PRODUCER
description:
Job Summary

The Junior Creative Producer plays an integral role in supporting the execution of L’AGENCE's creative vision across campaigns, e-commerce photography, and brand initiatives. Working closely with the Creative Producer and VP of Creative, this individual helps bring creative concepts to life through thoughtful planning, seamless coordination, and strong attention to detail.

The ideal candidate has a refined aesthetic sensibility, exceptional organizational skills, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can confidently manage day-to-day responsibilities, and is eager to develop their creative production expertise.

With guidance and mentorship from the Creative Producer, the Junior Creative Producer will take ownership of assigned projects and production tasks while contributing to the continued evolution of L’AGENCE's visual identity.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Production & Photoshoots

  • Partner closely with the Creative Producer to support all phases of campaign, e-commerce, and editorial photoshoot production, from pre-production planning through on-set execution and post-production.
  • Ensure shoot readiness by proactively coordinating samples, props, creative collateral, and other essential production materials, adapting quickly to evolving priorities and last-minute changes.
  • Collaborate with the VP of Creative to research, source, and compile visual references, mood boards, and creative inspiration for upcoming campaigns and e-commerce shoots.
  • Anticipate upcoming sample and production needs, coordinating with relevant teams to ensure timely delivery and prevent disruptions to shoot schedules.
  • Assist in coordinating production logistics, including location scouting, permits, vendor sourcing, third-party partnerships, and other shoot-related requirements.
  • Maintain professional relationships and ongoing communication with external vendors, production partners, and creative collaborators.
  • Prepare and organize essential production materials, including shot lists, pre-production decks, schedules, and other creative documentation.
  • Coordinate travel logistics for models, crew, and creative partners, including flights, hotel accommodations, and transportation.
  • Provide on-set production support, helping manage logistics, troubleshoot challenges, and maintain an organized and efficient shooting environment.
  • Proactively communicate project updates, potential challenges, and shifting priorities to the Creative Producer, identifying solutions whenever possible.
  • Assist with post-production coordination, including content delivery tracking, video deliverables decks, asset reviews, and quality control as directed.
  • Support the organization, management, and archiving of post-shoot assets to ensure files are properly maintained and accessible to relevant teams.
  • Demonstrate flexibility, adaptability, and a willingness to receive and implement creative feedback while continuously refining production skills.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Serve as a key point of contact for sample coordination, creative assets, and production-related requests across departments.
  • Maintain consistent communication with Merchandising, Creative, and Marketing teams to align on sample availability, inventory, delivery timelines, and upcoming shoot requirements.
  • Proactively track outstanding requests and deliverables, following up with internal stakeholders to ensure projects remain on schedule.
  • Support the VP of Creative on retail-related initiatives by coordinating creative assets, project timelines, and cross-functional communication to ensure cohesive brand storytelling across in-store environments.
  • Foster strong working relationships across departments, promoting clear communication, accountability, and an efficient creative workflow.

Key Attributes & Skills

  • Strong visual sensibility with an appreciation for fashion, photography, branding, and creative storytelling.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to anticipate needs and take initiative.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative and professional approach.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced creative environment where priorities and timelines may shift.
  • Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities while recognizing when to escalate questions or challenges.
  • Strong follow-through, accountability, and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
  • Positive attitude, curiosity, and a genuine desire to learn and grow within creative production.

Physical Requirements:

  • This position requires frequent use of a computer, mouse and keyboard.
  • Frequent sitting, standing, walking
  • Occasional bending, stooping.
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

title: Purchasing & Logistics Officer
description:
Job Nature:

This is a hands-on operational role, not a desk-only or managerial position. Daily follow-up with suppliers, shipping companies, and internal teams is required

We are looking for a hands-on Purchasing & Logistics Officer to manage the full product cycle from supplier to warehouse and branches, including procurement, shipping, customs clearance, inventory entry, and distribution.

Key Responsibilities:

• Source products and communicate with suppliers and factories

• Request quotations, negotiate prices, and create Purchase Orders (PO)

• Follow up on production and order readiness

• Coordinate with freight forwarders and shipping companies

• Handle customs clearance processes with brokers

• Ensure all shipping documents are complete (Invoice, Packing List, HS Code)

• Track shipments until arrival and resolve delays

• Receive goods and ensure quantity/quality accuracy

• Perform GRPO and product coding (SKU creation) in the system

• Monitor warehouse and branch inventory levels

• Replenish branches based on demand and stock levels

⸻

Inventory Analysis & Planning:

• Analyze stock movement (Fast / Slow / Dead Stock)

title: Information Technology Director
description:
Full-Time, Exempt

Hybrid Eligible



Summary

Leads information technology strategy and development for Meals on Wheels Central Texas—building and improving the applications, integrations, and automation our programs and business lines run on. This role sets the direction for the organization’s business systems—Salesforce, Microsoft 365, the Microsoft Power Platform, integrations, and automation—and is accountable for delivering the technology outcomes in the organization’s strategic priorities, including ensuring every department has the digital tools it needs and that staff actively adopt them. The Director leads the IT team, turns the needs of our business lines into improved processes and applications, manages the technology budget and vendors, and serves as the organization’s primary technology partner to leadership and departments. The Director actively engages, coordinates, and supervises volunteers who contribute to technology projects, and builds volunteer engagement into how the IT team plans and delivers its work. The focus of the role is modernization, development, and measurable adoption; routine system administration and user support are performed by the IT team under standards set by the Director. IT infrastructure, including networks, devices, and phones, is overseen by the Senior Director, Business Operations.


Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Roadmap (20%)

•Define, own, and execute the organization’s technology roadmap in alignment with its strategic priorities, and report progress to leadership

•Design and lead the organization-wide technology needs assessment, and prioritize tools and improvements for each department

•Analyze and redesign business processes with departments before automating them

•Evaluate where AI and automation create real, responsible value for staff, volunteers, and neighbors

•Make build-versus-buy decisions, and consolidate or retire underused and redundant systems

•Evaluate opportunities to share technology infrastructure with peer aging-services organizations

Software Development and Integration (25%)

•Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of custom applications, integrations, and automation across Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and the Power Platform

•Architect integrations and APIs between internal platforms and external partner, payment, and reporting systems

•Personally build the most complex solutions, and direct and review the development work of IT staff and contractors

•Set development standards for sandbox-to-production release management, code review, testing, and technical documentation

Platform Ownership and Adoption (20%)

•Own Salesforce and the Power Platform as enterprise platforms, including their architecture, roadmap, and governance

•Deliver the technology that supports strategic initiatives, including meal sales and payment systems, volunteer retention tracking, partner and referral tracking, holistic neighbor onboarding, and program cost and impact reporting

•Ensure technology tools support volunteer engagement, onboarding, and retention across the organization

•Measure adoption through active-use tracking and staff feedback, and ensure tools that prove hard to use are fixed

•Lead change management so new tools become part of everyday work across departments

Team and Volunteer Leadership, Budget, and Vendors (20%)

•Lead, supervise, and develop the Manager, IT Support and Training, and IT volunteers; set team priorities and workload

•Manage IT contractors, including the Developer, Technology Solutions (Contract): set project priorities, deliverables, and technical standards, and accept completed work

•Engage, coordinate, and supervise skilled technology volunteers (such as developers, analysts, trainers, and data volunteers) on IT projects, and define higher-responsibility volunteer roles on the IT team with clear training paths

•Apply a volunteer-first check when planning new technology work, identifying where volunteers can contribute

•Build the IT team’s capabilities in development, process improvement, adoption support, and volunteer engagement

•Develop and manage the technology budget; own business systems and software vendor relationships, contracts, and licensing

•Lead cross-functional technology projects with program, volunteer, development, and finance teams

Governance, Security, and Data Architecture (15%)

•Set enterprise data architecture and data model standards, and approve data model changes across Salesforce, Dataverse, and connected systems

•Set and verify standards for system performance, backup, recovery, and data integrity; routine maintenance is performed by the IT team

•Maintain access lifecycle management, change control, application security, and audit readiness for business systems, coordinating with the Senior Director on infrastructure security

•Ensure systems meet organizational policies and the data and reporting requirements of funders and contracts

•Maintain technical architecture documentation and system runbooks


Qualifications

•Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

•7+ years of experience in software development, systems engineering, business systems, or technology leadership, including at least 3 years supervising staff or leading technical teams

•Hands-on programming experience in two or more of Apex, JavaScript, Python, or C#

•Demonstrated Salesforce development and administration experience; Salesforce Platform Developer or Architect certification preferred

•Experience building solutions with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse)

•Experience with system architecture, API integration, data modeling, and release management

•Track record of delivering a technology roadmap and achieving measurable user adoption

•Experience managing technology budgets, vendors, and contracts

•Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate clearly with non-technical staff

•Experience engaging, coordinating, and supervising volunteers

•Experience applying AI and automation responsibly in business processes preferred

•Nonprofit or human services experience preferred


Workplace Environment and Physical Demands

This role may work in an office, field, or service setting and requires regular use of computers and standard equipment. Physical demands include prolonged periods of sitting or standing, moving within the workspace, and occasional lifting or transporting of items up to 35–50 pounds. Communication via phone, email, and in-person is essential. Reasonable accommodations will be made in accordance with ADA standards.

This position is hybrid eligible. In accordance with organizational policy, the employee and their manager establish the number of days worked remotely, in the office, and in the field.



Meals on Wheels Central Texas provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Product Marketer
description:
Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketer to help bring Samaya’s products to market for a highly technical enterprise audience across AI, data platforms, and finance.

You’ll play a central role in translating complex product capabilities into clear, credible messaging for customers, prospects, and internal teams. This role will own core product marketing work across feature launches, positioning, messaging, email and communications cadence, social media support, and enablement content.

The right candidate will be both strategic and hands-on: someone who can create structure out of ambiguity, partner closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, and leadership, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. We’re looking for someone who is creative as well as analytical, with strong judgment, excellent communication skills, and the range to contribute beyond a narrow product marketing lane as the marketing function continues to grow.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with potential to grow into people management over time.

Responsibilities

  • Own product launches - lead end-to-end product marketing for feature and product launches, from positioning and messaging through rollout, adoption, and follow-up
  • Shape the story - translate complex technical product concepts into simple, credible narratives for technical, commercial, and executive audiences
  • Partner cross-functionally - work closely with Product, Engineering, GTM, and leadership to bring new features and capabilities to market
  • Build launch assets - create launch plans and supporting materials across email, social, internal enablement, customer-facing content, and sales support
  • Develop enablement - build materials that clearly communicate product value, use cases, differentiation, and customer relevance
  • Bring market insight - gather customer, market, and competitive insights to sharpen messaging and improve go-to-market execution
  • Analytically minded - you know that events are not just vibes, you not only setrack success metrics, and how to evaluate event effectiveness and ROI
  • Use AI fluently - test and apply AI tools and workflows to improve the quality and speed of research, messaging, launches, and content development
  • Support broader marketing priorities - contribute across content, campaigns, customer storytelling, and other high-impact go-to-market initiatives as the team evolves

Experience

Required

  • Product marketing experience - 8+ years of experience in product marketing or closely related roles
  • Technical product depth - proven success marketing highly technical products to enterprise audiences
  • Launch ownership - strong ownership of feature or product launches in fast-moving software companies where you have owned everything from creative to metrics
  • Relevant category experience - experience in AI, financial services, data platforms, infrastructure, developer tooling, analytics, or similarly technical product categories
  • Clear communication - strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for both technical and business audiences
  • Technical translation - a track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and credible messaging
  • Asset creation - strength in building high-quality launch materials, emails, enablement content, customer-facing materials, and other go-to-market assets
  • Cross-functional partnership - proven ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and leadership
  • Startup operating style - comfort operating with pace, ambiguity, and high accountability in a fast-moving environment
  • AI fluency - demonstrated AI fluency in a concrete way, such as building, testing, or integrating AI-driven workflows into how you work

Preferred

  • AI and enterprise software experience – experience marketing products in AI, data infrastructure, analytics, developer tools, or other technical enterprise software categories
  • Financial services exposure – familiarity marketing into financial services, investment firms, or highly analytical end-user audiences
  • Broad marketing experience – experience contributing across content, campaigns, customer storytelling, and sales enablement
  • People leadership experience – prior experience managing people or mentoring teammates in a fast-moving environment

Personal Attributes

  • Resourceful and proactive - you thrive in lean environments, spot what needs to be done, and move work forward without waiting for perfect direction
  • Creative and Analytical - you love being creative but you know you have to measure for it to count - you are metrics oriented with a healthy dose of right brain
  • Strong communicator - you can make technical ideas understandable without oversimplifying them
  • Curious - you take time to understand the product, the customer, and the market because the “why” matters to your work
  • Sound judgment - you know when to decide, when to escalate, and how to keep stakeholders aligned
  • Highly adaptable - you’re comfortable moving across product marketing, content, enablement, campaigns, and broader marketing needs
  • Commercially aware - you understand how messaging, launches, and enablement connect to go-to-market outcomes
  • Leadership-oriented - you may have managed people before, or you’re interested in growing into people leadership over time

Compensation

The cash compensation range for this role is $150,000-$200,000.

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including experience and expertise, and may vary from the amount listed above.

Equity components may also be considered as part of the overall compensation package.

Benefits

Health: Access comprehensive health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, flexible spending account (FSA), and short-term disability.

Wealth: Support for your long-term financial wellbeing with a 401(k) and pre-tax benefits.

Rest: Enjoy flexibility to rest and recharge as needed, with unlimited PTO.

Flexibility: Work flexibly with a hybrid setup, with team members typically spending a minimum of three days in the office per week.

Travel: Grow and connect with a travel budget that supports conferences, customer visits, and team gatherings.

Equipment: Create your ideal workspace with an equipment allowance to support how you work best.

Inclusive Hiring

Interview Accommodations: We are committed to ensuring an equitable selection process for everyone and welcome applicants from varied backgrounds to enrich our team. If you require accommodations or adjustments during our recruitment process, please inform us.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, membership in an employee organization, retaliation, parental status, military service, or other non-merit factor.

Visa Sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

About Samaya

Samaya AI builds Expert AI Agents for investment professionals, supporting high-stakes investment workflows across leading financial institutions. By combining finance-specific AI models with deep reasoning over institutional context and global markets, Samaya helps investors go from information to conviction. Samaya is deployed at enterprise scale across hedge funds, asset managers, and banks, including more than 12,000 professionals at one of the world's largest financial institutions. Built by a team from Google DeepMind, Meta, Microsoft, and Stanford with 100+ papers and 50k+ citations, it achieves 98% accuracy on financial reasoning tasks where generic LLMs reach 53%. Backed by leading AI investors including NVIDIA, Databricks Ventures, NEA, Eric Schmidt, and Yann LeCun, Samaya continues to advance the next generation of AI for investment professionals.

Our Operating Principles

Put Users first. Our users rely on us to do their jobs. We exist because our users trust us to help them achieve their goals. In return for this trust users place in us, we keep their needs as our top priority.

Win as a collective. We are high achievers with a drive to succeed. We build strong bonds over this shared drive. We dive in to help when one of us needs it. We’re kind to each other and boost each other to succeed and grow professionally and personally. We build trust with each other by making commitments and consistently delivering on them. This trust means we genuinely support each other, embracing feedback as a tool for growth and improvement. We win by operating this way, as one team.

Focus and iterate quickly. Bias for action makes us build and learn quickly. Iterating fast requires clarity on what outcomes we are targeting and why. Prioritizing the important things, taking full ownership and initiative, making fast initial progress, and rapid iterations lead to the best outcomes.

Innovate Relentlessly. We pursue novel insights, challenging the status quo and reimagining how things are done. We aren’t attached to the past when improving our product and how we work in the future. We actively invest time in innovation, thinking “outside the box” to consistently raise our standards.

Prioritize Outcomes over Egos. We are committed not to a person, an idea, or an opinion but to continuously making progress to our goals. Sometimes, our goals are ambiguous; in those moments, we iterate, learn, and move on to the next inquiry. We ask the tough questions with kindness, dropping our egos in our pursuit of evidence. For our business goals, we learn from our users. For our scientific goals, our understanding is built through rigorous experimentation, research, and observation. For our personal goals, we embrace candid feedback and collaborative learning to guide our progress.
